proposal.summary: File upload vulnerability in DWSurvey DWSurvey-OSS v.3.2.0 and earlier allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the saveimage method and savveFile in action/UploadAction.java.
proposal.cwe_quote: File Upload vulnerability in DWSurvey DWSurvey-OSS v.3.2.0 and before allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the saveimage method and savveFile in the action/UploadAction.java file.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Attempt to reproduce the issue against DWSurvey-OSS 3.2.0 in a controlled environment by exercising the saveimage and savveFile code paths in action/UploadAction.java to confirm remote code execution and capture a proof-of-concept.
